content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Los Alamos

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—typically a secondary degree paired with professional PM hours, or a four-year degree with fewer hours required. Gather your project documentation before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Attend all sessions synchronously from Los Alamos on your schedule; no commute required. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world scenarios and frameworks aligned to PMI's current exam content outline.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and complete the formal PMP® application, including your education, work history, and training documentation. Pay PMI's examination fee directly. Allow time for PMI's application review process before your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce knowledge and build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. You'll receive your results immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, leading projects, contributing to the profession, or giving back to your community. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep it active in your local and national job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
